name: Rainy Window
description: Simulates rain on a window that distorts the view. Use the mouse to wipe the glass clean.

name: Ink Marbling
description: Distorts the image with fluid, ink-like domain warping.

name: Kimi Liquid Glass
description: Realistic liquid surface with caustics, chromatic refraction, and specular highlights.

name: Liquid Displacement
description: Navier-Stokes fluid simulation for realistic water-like displacement. Features swirling eddies, vortices, and volume-conserving flow with pressure projection.

name: Liquid Fast
description: Fast analytical liquid ripples with low-sample motion blur, depth-aware flow, audio acceleration, and spectral edge highlights.

name: Liquid Glitch
description: Block-quantized liquid smearing with audio-reactive signal corruption, chromatic splitting, click bursts, and temporal datamosh trails.

params.name: Flow Corruption
params.description: Liquid smear and signal corruption intensity

name: Liquid Jelly
description: Coral/aqua bioluminescent Kelvin–Voigt jelly with layered gelatin lobes, traveling soliton ridges, fast shear, sharp subsurface highlights, and bounded advected trails.
feedbackPacking: A/C = display RGBA history; exact bounded advected loads

name: Liquid Metal
description: PBR mercury surface with FBM height field, Schlick-Fresnel reflectance, chromatic RGB dispersion, depth-aware pooling, and audio-reactive surface pulsing.

name: Liquid Mirror
description: Fast mercury ribbons fold into mirror seams with cobalt/rose accents, moving reflection sweeps, click waves, and held push/pull deformation.

name: Liquid Oil
description: Warm petrol marbling in black, amber, teal, and oxidized orange, driven by advected vortex cells, tendrils, click stirring, and a fast conveyor flow.

name: Liquid Optimized (Pass 1)
description: Physics simulation pass: capillary wave dynamics, Laplace pressure, ripple propagation, and ambient micro-ripples. Outputs height field state to dataTextureA.

name: Liquid Surface Tension (Optimized)
description: Surface tension liquid simulation with shared memory optimization. Uses workgroup-local caching to reduce texture fetches by 80% for 8-10x performance improvement. Audio reactivity drives ambient wave amplitude and virtual ripple sources.

name: Liquid (Pass 1)
description: Capillary wave physics pass: surface tension simulation with Laplacian and biharmonic operators, gravity waves, ripple sources, and ambient micro-ripples. Outputs persistent height field to dataTextureA.

name: Liquid Perspective
description: A perspective-compressed three-wave Gerstner sheet with a depth-aware parallax Jacobian, silhouette-safe refraction, secondary shear flow, and bioluminescent click crests.

params.name: Density
params.description: Spatial frequency of the perspective flow

feedbackPacking: A/C = final tone-mapped display RGBA; exact bounded parallax history loads

name: Liquid Rainbow Prismatic
description: Cauchy-separated RGB refraction through animated thin-film thickness, a six-tap caustic kernel, held lens deformation, and prismatic click fronts.
feedbackPacking: A/C = final tone-mapped display RGBA; exact bounded refractive history loads

name: Liquid Rainbow
description: Braided spectral ribbons and layered trochoidal crests race through vortex transport, sharp thin-film bands, and energetic click fronts.

params.name: Viscosity
params.description: Flow damping and spectral film thickness

feedbackPacking: A/C = display RGBA history; exact bounded loads

name: Liquid RGB
description: Independently advected wavelength channels curl through vortex-flow dispersion, Beer–Lambert absorption, chromatic caustic seams, and held or click-driven shear.
feedbackPacking: A/C = final tone-mapped display RGBA; exact bounded wavelength-flow history loads

name: Liquid Smear
description: Anisotropic multi-tap wet-paint advection with viscous streamline diffusion, broad bass wakes, midrange-bent drag flow, treble-lit ridges, and click eddies.
feedbackPacking: A/C = final tone-mapped display RGBA; exact bounded advected loads

name: Liquid Tensor Vortex
description: Source-luma structure-tensor eigenflow advects liquid metal through curl vortices, coherent folds, held-pointer torque, and click-launched metallic fronts.
feedbackPacking: A/C = final tone-mapped display RGBA; exact bounded tensor-flow loads

name: Liquid Viscous Nebula grokcf1
description: Cosmic viscous flow with multi-octave nebula warping, emissive veins, depth parallax, audio reactivity, and persistent trails.

name: Liquid Viscous (Simple)
description: An efficient laminar streamline field with a lightweight cohesion stencil, shear-thinning response, spectral surface sheen, and held or click-driven vortices.
feedbackPacking: A/C = final tone-mapped display RGBA; exact bounded laminar history loads

name: Liquid Viscous
description: A bounded exact-load semi-Lagrangian liquid state with viscosity diffusion, one-frame Jacobi pressure projection, vorticity confinement, and audio-driven dye roll-up.
feedbackPacking: A/C = velocity.xy, dye, pressure; raw bounded state via exact loads

name: Liquid Zoom
description: Three depth-layered liquid zoom streams pass through a moving refractive surface with zoom-coupled vortices, held lens deformation, click fronts, and bounded temporal trails.
feedbackPacking: A/C = final tone-mapped display RGBA; exact bounded liquid-zoom history loads

description: Luma-thresholded cohesive rivulets branch under heat-dependent viscosity, held-pointer melting, exact advected history, and aspect-correct click fronts.
feedbackPacking: A/C = final tone-mapped display RGBA; exact bounded melt-history loads
name: Luma Melt
Luma Velocity Melt
description: Image melts downwards with curl-noise turbulence. Bright pixels drip faster; chromatic separation makes R/B channels drip at different rates. Audio heat pulses and depth viscosity modulate flow.

name: Rain Ripples
description: Interactive water ripples and raindrops with FBM micro-ripples, depth-aware fog, displacement-driven chromatic aberration, specular highlights, and ACES tone mapping.

params.name: Intensity
params.description: Overall ripple displacement and depth-fog influence

params.name: Detail
params.description: Wave sharpness and chromatic aberration amount

name: Viscous Drag
description: Diffused drag state drives traveling jets, pressure and thickness buildup, elastic recovery, held-pointer smears, click fronts, and illuminated viscous ridges.
feedbackPacking: A/C = offset.xy, thickness, drag energy; raw bounded state via exact loads
